payload.title: AI Solutions: engagements large, projects and examples in a grid
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-09-26: the solutions page mixed small examples with serious long-term engagements. Solutions tagged engagement (Call Criteria, DataParade, Venue Driver, Vault) render large with the image beside the text; every other non-integration solution plus articles tagged project render in the small card grid below, sorted by date. Integrations unchanged. Move an item between tiers by changing its tag.
